description: Follow a copy-trade leader from the authenticated account, defining how their trades are mirrored into your own wallet. MONEY-ADJACENT: this sets how much of YOUR SOL each copy may spend. Non-custodial — three.ws never signs or holds funds; it emits sized, guard-checked copy INTENTS you act on. Idempotent: re-calling with the same leader_agent_id + network updates that subscription (and re-activates it) rather than creating a duplicate. Sizing rule: "fixed" spends fixed_sol per copy; "multiplier" spends multiplier × the leader's entry; "pct_balance" spends pct_balance % of your spendable SOL. Every order is clamped to per_trade_cap_sol and the remaining daily_budget_sol. Returns the created/updated subscription. Requires THREE_WS_API_KEY.

copier_wallet.description: Your own Solana wallet address that will execute the mirrored trades. Never a private key — non-custodial.

copy_sells.description: Mirror the leader's exits, not just entries (default true).

daily_budget_sol.description: Max SOL fanned out across copies per UTC day (default 1). Must be > 0.

fixed_sol.description: SOL spent per copy when sizing_rule="fixed". Required for fixed sizing.

leader_agent_id.description: UUID of the public leader (agent with a sniper track record) to follow.

max_open_copies.description: Cap on concurrent pending copy intents (1–100, default 5).

mcap_ceiling_usd.description: Skip coins above this market cap (USD). Omit/null to ignore.

mcap_floor_usd.description: Skip coins below this market cap (USD). Omit/null to ignore.

min_oracle_score.description: Skip coins whose Oracle conviction score is below this (0–100). Omit/null to ignore.

min_order_sol.description: Skip dust copies sized below this, in SOL (default 0.02). Cannot exceed per_trade_cap_sol.

multiplier.description: Fraction of the leader's entry size to copy when sizing_rule="multiplier" (default 0.1).

pct_balance.description: Percent of your spendable SOL per copy when sizing_rule="pct_balance" (0–100).

per_trade_cap_sol.description: Hard ceiling on any single copy, in SOL (default 0.5). Must be > 0.

perf_fee_bps.description: Leader's performance fee on your realized copy profit, in basis points (0–3000, default 1000 = 10%). Charged above a high-water mark, settled in $THREE.

require_safety_pass.description: Skip a copy when the coin's safety context cannot be confirmed (default false).

sizing_rule.description: How each copy is sized: fixed | multiplier (× leader entry) | pct_balance (% of your SOL). Default fixed.

telegram_chat_id.description: Optional Telegram chat ID to receive copy-intent alerts for this subscription.
